assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one production game backdrop for Kids & Dragons, Gemfall chapter 03a, 'queue-camp-crabs'. Landscape 16:9, 1920x1080 composition. Match the supplied reference ONLY for polished painterly storybook medium, dimensional soft brushwork, tactile wood, stone, plants, and warm child-friendly fantasy atmosphere. New place: dusk at the stone-crossing queue, on a wide river bank. In the middle distance, a small orderly camp of folded wool blankets and a large soup pot beside an unlit cooking tripod, a few sturdy wooden gem carts carrying covered crates with a faint amber and teal glow seeping from seams. A gentle bank slopes toward the broad river and the first stones of an old crossing; orange sunset sky with violet clouds and distant wooded hills. No people, no creatures, no crabs, no silhouettes, no readable text, numbers, labels, letters, UI, border, frame or watermark. Full bleed environment painting, no split panels. Reference scene is not the subject: do not copy its ditch, planks, cake table or hay cart.

Reference image is STYLE ONLY: match its polished dimensional painterly storybook brushwork, tactile natural materials, inviting family-friendly fantasy for children age 8. New scene: quiet marsh shallows, dark teal slow water crossed by a small bank and an ancient worn stone step in the upper-middle of frame. On the step a charming gleaming heap of objects lost by travelers: several mismatched silver and brass spoons, tiny colorful buttons, a copper teapot lid, little beads and a bent buckle, clearly mundane lost things, not coins or treasure chests. Mossy stone, tall knotted reeds framing the sides, hanging willow foliage, floating leaves and soft luminous mist. Late-afternoon soft gold filters through the green canopy onto the stone and objects; cool blue-green water, gentle mystery without danger. Lower third broad clear shallow-water/muddy bank for separately rendered character sprites; keep large props and reeds at edges or upper two thirds, central mobile crop readable. Absolutely no people, no animals, no crabs, no wisps or creatures, no silhouettes, no face shapes. No text, letters, numbers, UI, frame or watermark. Full bleed single painting. Do not copy the reference's ditch, planks, hay cart, cake table or countryside road.
